scope: Read-only planner inspection; root active-suite database untouched. No ANALYZE, no server/session configuration change, no runtime edits or heavy tests.
method: Inline node --input-type=module: SELECT pg_settings; choose existing synthetic account/run; execute EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, VERBOSE, SETTINGS) with same two parameter values three times; save raw plans. Exact SQL/settings/parameters in explain.json.
conclusion: JIT overhead is not supported for this retained-basis target plan. Planning/client roundtrip overhead exists before any query execution, but these samples do not isolate PostgreSQL planning time or attribute full-suite CPU/latency. Root active database may have different statistics/plans.
nextMeasurement: After the frozen suite, use a fixed retained synthetic original+correction evidence basis and EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) to separate planning/execution, with repeated identical parameters. Compare any reduced redundant-join or prepared-plan candidate only after preserving exact ownership/version/access/deletion behavior and unchanged query results; no speedup claim now.
